description: Semantic search across an indexed codebase. Only use after codebase_index is complete (check codebase_status first). Returns relevant code chunks matching a natural language query.

fileFilter.description: Filter results to one file, given exactly as a result header shows its path (e.g. 'src/index.ts'). Directories, globs, lists and bare names of files below the root match nothing.

includeLinked.description: When true, also search across linked projects defined in .socraticode.json or SOCRATICODE_LINKED_PROJECTS env var. Results include a project label showing which project each result came from. Default: false.

languageFilter.description: Filter results to one language, given exactly as a result header shows its label in brackets (e.g. 'typescript', 'python', 'go'); aliases such as 'ts' or 'py' match nothing.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 10 (override globally via SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT env var).

minScore.description: Minimum RRF score threshold (0-1). Results below this are filtered out. Default: 0.10 (override globally via SEARCH_MIN_SCORE env var). Set to 0 to disable filtering.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g. 'authentication middleware', 'database connection setup').

name: codebase_search
